name: EuroHPC Quantum Grand Challenge
description: The EuroHPC Quantum Grand Challenge invites European quantum computing startups to develop integrated hardware-software solutions with strong market potential. Phase 1 provides EUR 4 million in funding for technical roadmaps and prototypes, with the most promising projects advancing to Phase 2 for European Investment Bank venture debt financing. Priority is given to solutions integrating with existing EU supercomputing centres.
prizes: EUR 4 million Phase 1 funding; Phase 2 EIB venture debt
